$description: The dark theme (decisions 0054 and 0056). Generated by scripts/generate-palette.mjs from scripts/palette/params.mjs: do not edit by hand. Each ramp step keeps its job, so 100 is the page and 1200 primary text, and the role tokens (solid fills, surfaces, inks, the scrim opacity and shadows) come from the same rules as light. Semantic tokens read the same paths in both themes. The theme modifier in src/tokens/resolver.json applies it as [data-co-theme="dark"] in tokens.css.
